target.title: Harden Program Manager behavioral evals and handoff safety
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Program Manager had strong static/smoke coverage but still had unproven behavioral output quality, no runtime telemetry emission path, and insufficient protection against unsafe indirect execution through configured delegation targets. This PR hardens Program Manager so it stays planning/status-only, emits non-secret telemetry through the agent event bus, rejects unsupported completion claims, and fails closed when configured delegation targets expose high-risk tools without deny/always approval posture.

## Summary
- add sectioned Program Manager behavioral live eval contracts and enforcement
- add canonical Program Manager state freshness metadata checks and telemetry validation fixtures
- implement Program Manager runtime telemetry on the `program_manager_telemetry` agent-event stream
- require handoff packets only and remove Program Manager `sessions_send` from allowed tools
- add static delegation-target safety checks for Program Manager handoffs
- include Program Manager safety, efficiency, and behavioral contracts in scheduled live eval defaults

## Evidence
- `pnpm docs:list`
- `pnpm openclaw config validate` — passed with existing version warning
- `pnpm openclaw approvals get --json` — passed; Program Manager, Judge, and Telemetry Evaluation Analyst now show `security=deny`, `ask=always`, `askFallback=deny` for exec
- `node scripts/agent-role-eval.mjs --agent program-manager --json` — passed with warning-only UNKNOWN canonical state
- `node scripts/agent-role-eval.mjs --contracts-only --json` — passed
- focused delegation-target static verification for Program Manager plus configured delegation targets — passed
- `pnpm test test/scripts/agent-role-eval.test.ts src/infra/agent-events.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose` — passed, 95 tooling tests and 14 infra tests
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 scripts/lib/agent-role-evals.mjs test/scripts/agent-role-eval.test.ts src/infra/agent-events.ts src/infra/agent-events.test.ts` — passed
- `git diff --check -- control/docs control/state scripts/lib/agent-role-evals.mjs test/scripts/agent-role-eval.test.ts src/infra/agent-events.ts src/infra/agent-events.test.ts` — passed
- `env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 pnpm build` — passed
- live evals against `ollama/openclaw-control-qwen25-32b:latest` passed for `program-manager`, `program-manager-safety-boundary`, `program-manager-efficiency-routing`, `program-manager-full-output`, `program-manager-unsupported-completion`, `program-manager-handoff-telemetry-full`, and `program-manager-stale-work-full`

## Remaining Known Gap

Program Manager canonical state files intentionally remain `UNKNOWN` until an approved trusted truth source is provided. The static role eval correctly reports these as warning-level `program_manager_canonical_state_unknown` and does not allow real status claims from unknown state.
